title: cairn cleanup reaches the inspector's recheck through a codemother verb
intention: cairn cleanup reaches the build inspector's recheck over the bus, through codemother's inspect verb and the published inspect_wire tool, never through her module path.
why: RULE 1 (encapsulation): bin/cmd/cleanup:80 runs `python3 -m cairn.devices.codemother.machines.build_inspector.inspector --recheck $ids`, reaching into device codemother's code from outside it. RULE 1 says a device's public interface is the bus plus the client tools it publishes. encapsulation_holds reads only .py imports, so it cannot see a shell `-m`. bin/proofs/test_cleanup_rechecks_the_standing_findings_first.py:56 finds its stub by regex over that same `python3 -m` line. Recorded as residue at 93fa3e3a6199's move, which left it out of scope.
traces_to: RULE 1; Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics)
how: D1: add "recheck" to INSPECT_JUDGES in cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py (module build_inspector.inspector), the allow-list codemother's inspect verb answers. D2: the findings step in bin/cmd/cleanup runs `python3 -c 'import json,sys; from cairn.tools.inspect_wire.inspect_wire import ask; print(json.dumps(ask("recheck", sys.argv[1:]), indent=2))' $ids` in place of `python3 -m ...inspector --recheck $ids`. Its stdout keeps the same JSON, and an InspectRefused exits non-zero. bin/proofs/test_cleanup_rechecks_the_standing_findings_first.py stops locating a stub module by regex over cleanup's text, and stubs what cleanup now reaches. D3: red-first proof cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_cleanup_asks_the_recheck_over_the_bus.py, one tooth per clause, asking over a scratch codemother (inspect_wire.launch).

clauses.claim: over a scratch codemother bus, inspect_wire.ask('recheck', ids) returns what inspector.recheck(ids) returns for the same ids; with 'recheck' off INSPECT_JUDGES the same ask raises InspectRefused naming it
bin/cmd/cleanup names no `cairn.devices.` module; its findings step asks the recheck through inspect_wire, and the standing inspector-new-finding-* ids arrive there, and only those

decisions.text: D1: "recheck" joins codemother's inspect allow-list in cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py.
D2: bin/cmd/cleanup's findings step asks over the bus through inspect_wire; bin/proofs/test_cleanup_rechecks_the_standing_findings_first.py follows it.
D3: red-first proof cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_cleanup_asks_the_recheck_over_the_bus.py, one tooth per clause.
